Pi: source separates RL and WM learning components and response alternatives/accumulators
C: WM capacity constrains source WM contribution; set size remains source task context L_ctx rather than a new primitive C unless used as explicit threshold parameter
Q: RL/WM action policies and final mixture policy orient response evidence
decision threshold is source-defined choice criterion, not generic executive
P_in: stimulus, reward/correctness feedback and block set-size cue
P_out: selected response and RT from first accumulator crossing
T: trial sequence, within-block delay, accumulation time and learning-update order
rho/O: learning/accuracy traces; fitted posterior summaries remain L_claim/L_formal analysis rather than cognitive state

L_ctx: Source task/experimental conditions remain explicit and are not retyped into C solely because they are called conditions.
L_claim: Negative, null, approximation, genealogy and epistemic qualifications remain claim-layer assertions rather than added system roles.
L_formal: Algorithmic inference/search/fitting carriers are kept distinct from source-supported cognitive state; formal plumbing cannot create a coordinator.

system_world_experiment.system: RL state, WM state, source mixture, decision accumulators and threshold
system_world_experiment.world: stimulus-response block, set-size cue and reinforcement feedback
system_world_experiment.boundary: task cues/reward enter P_in; response/RT leave P_out; fit posterior is not internal system state
